verdict.rationale: A published uptime SLA and public status page are fair questions for a SaaS work-management platform like monday.com, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an uptime SLA, availability commitments, or a status/incident page. The SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 certification claims are adjacent compliance evidence and do not establish either capability.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's published uptime SLA and can check real-time incident status via a public status page
